name: Global Fellowship with Full Consensus and Complete Coverage
question: What is the award stipend, application deadline, and required documents for the 2026 Global AI Fellowship?

sources.title: Global AI Fellowship 2026 Official Guidelines
sources.cleanedText: Announcing the 2026 Global AI Research Fellowship for Academic Year 2026-27. Published on 10 February 2026. The fellowship provides an annual award stipend of $50,000 to selected postdoctoral researchers. The application deadline is 15 April 2026. Required documents are research proposal, CV, and two recommendation letters. Apply via portal at https://fellowship.institute.edu.
